totalPages.description: Total page count — omit for unbounded mode

pages.description: Pre-computed list of page items: [{type: 'page', page: N} | {type: 'ellipsis'}]. Compute server-side with Django's Paginator.

unbounded.description: True when total pages is unknown — hides the disabled state on Next

arrowsOnly.description: Show only the prev/next arrows, no page number buttons

prevLabel.description: Label for the previous arrow link

nextLabel.description: Label for the next arrow link

hideLinkText.description: Visually hide prev/next labels (still readable by screen readers)

pageUrlPrefix.description: URL prefix that the page number is appended to, e.g. '?page='

showSummary.description: Show the 'Showing X–Y of Z items' summary

firstItem.description: First item number on the current page (for summary)

lastItem.description: Last item number on the current page (for summary)

itemLabel.description: Noun for items in the summary (e.g. 'results', 'records')

stepOptionsId.description: HTML id for the step options select element

className.description: Additional CSS classes on the outer wrapper
